ranking.reason: Using >= lets a j-1 state whose color equals C1[j] evict the old best without saving it, losing a valid candidate.
Old top candidate is overwritten even when incoming color matches C1[j], so its value is silently dropped from the pair.
elif skips second-best update when equal to V1 but colors match; tied candidates with same color are mishandled.
On equal color, V1[j]=V2[j]+vi discards old V1[j]+vi which may still be a reachable larger value.
Adds vi unconditionally when colors differ; stale C1[j] states may need reset instead of accumulation.
Base case sets V1[0] to -INF on repeat color instead of keeping second-best structure used elsewhere.
